prerequisites: Artificial Intelligence, Data structures and algorithms, programming languages
description: To learn the fundamentals of Natural Language Processing and its algorithms. To understand machine translation and applications of NLP. Basic understanding of deep learning models for NLP.

syllabus.title: Introduction to NLP
syllabus.body: Characteristics of natural language, language and sentence structure, language analyzer, lexicon, word formation, morphology, syntax analysis (parsing), semantics, ambiguity, pragmatics and discourse.

syllabus.title: NLP Algorithms
syllabus.body: Understanding corpus and data attributes, corpus formats (CSV, JSON, XML, LibSVM), operations on text corpus, tokenisation, stop words, TF-IDF, text analysis and word embedding using word2vec, doc2vec, GLoVe, Bag-of-Words.

syllabus.title: Machine Translation and Applications of NLP
syllabus.body: Introduction to machine translation, approaches, structure of Anusaraka (an Interlingua based MT system), example/analogy based MT, word/phrase based MT, neural MT; applications: sentiment analysis, chatbots, conversational models for digital assistants.

syllabus.title: Deep Learning Models for NLP
syllabus.body: Neural net based NLP models: CNN, RNN, LSTM and GRU using the Natural Language Toolkit (NLTK).

outcomes: Understand the algorithmic approach to NLP.
Understand the sentence structure and the computational model of natural languages.
Understand the data science approach to machine translation and its applications.
Understand the machine learning approach to NLP.
textbooks: Thanaki, Jalaj, Python Natural Language Processing, Packt Publishing Ltd, 2017.
Daniel Jurafsky, James H. Martin, Speech and Language Processing, Pearson Publication, 2014.
